title: A fix PR carries a regression test and new identifiers carry no phase or ticket tokens
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19, standards enforcement audit after #1521 (operator: close every standards gap for good). Evidence: KRN-14/r-regression-layer: a fix PR needs a regression test, and no check requires one; r-role-names is checked on paths only (test/rules/path-token-guard.test.mjs), not on identifiers or test names.
Files: scripts/weak-tests.mjs, test/rules/path-token-guard.test.mjs
Outcome: CI rejects a PR whose title is fix(...) and whose diff changes no test file unless its body has a 'No-regression-test: <reason>' line; the token guard also scans added identifiers and test names for phase/ticket/round/date tokens.
Proof: node --test on both touched tests: a fix diff without a test fails, with one passes; an added test name with a ticket id fails.
